D5/S3/Weil/GronwallLowerEnvelope.gronwal.name: D5.S3.Weil.GronwallLowerEnvelope.gronwall_envelopes
D5/S3/Weil/GronwallLowerEnvelope.gronwal.signature: theorem gronwall_envelopes (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : (∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n : ℝ) / (Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * n * Real.log (Real.log n)) ≤ 1 + ε) ∧ (∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ 1 - ε ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n : ℝ) / (Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * n * Real.log (Real.log n)))
